answer: Bindings are kept in meadow, verified in mirror, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the whisper check. Repeating the trick 28 times costs 60 separate deposits and 25 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
